title: Virtual Compute: permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on cancellation
content:
## Meaning — permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on cancellation

Virtual Compute permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on cancellation: Whether customer termination forgives an unexpired signed commitment; boolean.

## Tier values — permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on cancellation

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on cancellation: not permitted.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on cancellation: not permitted.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on cancellation: not permitted.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on cancellation: not permitted.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on cancellation: not permitted.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on cancellation: not permitted.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on cancellation?**

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has permission to forgive an unexpired commitment on cancellation of not permitted.
